comment: Versioned condition -> visibility table for the v0.2 repair-eval path (issue #249). The no-feedback condition cannot see feedback, diagnosis, verification or hidden answers; verification stays sealed in every condition so the independent judge is never an input to the agent. gate/ is sealed in every condition: the evaluator source and its thresholds stay in the candidate only so the gate subprocess can run, and reading them would let a repair tune to the ruler instead of fixing the task. Editing this table is a protocol change: bump policy_id and record it in docs/repair_eval/VISIBILITY.md.

A_STATIC.comment: No feedback: the task goal, the regression definition and the candidate source only.

B_REAL_FEEDBACK.comment: The run's own execution feedback, raw and structured; the independent verdict stays sealed.

C_MISMATCHED_FEEDBACK.comment: Same information shape as B, drawn from one fixed other run; the packet is tagged mismatched=true with that run's id.

D_GUIDED.comment: B plus explicit bounded guidance from this policy document.
D_GUIDED.guidance: Consume the remaining retry budget before giving up: after a recoverable failure the decision must attempt recovery while budget remains, and abort only when the budget is exhausted.
